topic: Myth: more miners make Bitcoin blocks faster
hook: Myth: more miners means faster Bitcoin blocks. Here's why it's wrong.

scenes.narration: People assume that if more miners join, blocks arrive faster.
Every 2,016 blocks, about two weeks, Bitcoin recalculates difficulty.
If blocks come too quickly, difficulty rises, so the average stays close to ten minutes.

cta: Want to explore how digital Bitcoin mining works? Check the link on my channel page.
title: Myth: More Miners = Faster Bitcoin Blocks?
description_body: Bitcoin's difficulty adjustment keeps blocks near ten minutes however much hashrate joins.
